correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the exact one-particle trace formula and uses relative-gap equidistribution. Haar integration retains precisely signed edge multisets of zero incidence. At orders three and four this yields, after subtracting disconnected pairings, exactly the triangle and four-cycle terms plus the single-edge fourth cumulant. The forest equivalence follows from the primitive incidence lattice: forest edge differences extend to a unimodular angular coordinate system, whereas any cycle imposes an exact modular relation. The Berry–Esseen numerator and variance are evaluated exactly for each cosine summand. The packaged checker independently verifies a graph containing both a triangle and a four-cycle at nonzero phases, a representative forest coordinate determinant, and the prefactor algebra. No finite experiment is used to establish the general theorem.

value.rationale: The motivating source leaves generic Gaussian equilibration as a structural conjecture outside selected models. The accepted theorem supplies a natural graph object that explains when the source's independent-mode mechanism is exact, quantifies the finite-system normal approximation on the full forest class, and identifies the first topological non-Gaussian corrections through triangle and four-cycle fluxes. This is a reusable structural criterion and boundary diagnostic, not a numerical recomputation or an arbitrary parameter slice.
